material.acceptance_criteria: One helper converts tile coordinates to fixed point, refuses non-finite and out-of-map values with false/error text, and all five exports use it.
material.description: rust/crates/web/src/lib.rs:245-246,253-254,324-325,336-337 repeat (x as f64 * 65536.0) as i32, which maps NaN to 0 and infinity to i32::MAX silently; pointer (:144) hands f64 straight to Lua. mod-host fx_event (piccolo_host.rs:537) already refuses non-finite and is the pattern.
